title: Modern Magic
intro: [excited] Tonight we FAST FORWARD to the modern era, 2010 and beyond! Snowmen, demigods, magical houses, and more songs stuck in your head than you can count. If you have kids, you have heard every one of these movies about four hundred times. [laughs] Time to put that to use.

categories.title: We Do Talk About Bruno
categories.intro: Our film category is Encanto. Yes, we are finally talking about Bruno... [whispers] no, no, no.

clues.clue: Mirabel's cousin Luisa has this magical gift, and she can carry a church on her shoulders.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is super strength! Luisa can move donkeys, pianos, and entire buildings. [sighs] Surface pressure, it's real.

clues.clue: Mirabel's Tío Bruno has this gift, which makes the rest of the family very nervous.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is seeing the future! He told Pepa it would rain on her wedding day. [chuckles] To be fair, Pepa controls the weather. That one's on HER.

clues.clue: Encanto is set in the mountains of this South American country.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Colombia! The film's music is full of Colombian styles like cumbia and vallenato. [excited] Lin-Manuel Miranda did his homework.

clues.clue: The Madrigals' magical, living house is affectionately called this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Casita! It opens doors, waves shutters, and passes Mirabel the salt. [laughs] Honestly, the best roommate in Disney history.

clues.clue: Abuela Alma's husband, who sacrificed himself at the river to protect the family, was named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pedro! His sacrifice is what created the miracle, the candle, and Casita itself. [sighs] Pass the tissues.

art.prompt: A vibrant Colombian mountain village at golden hour, a two-story house with colorful tiles, open shutters and climbing flowers, a single magic candle glowing in an arched window, yellow butterflies. categories.title: Modern Marvels
categories.intro: Name the character or the place from Disney's modern classics. [chuckles] These are the movies on repeat in every minivan in America.

clues.clue: This summer-loving snowman from Frozen likes warm hugs.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Olaf! A snowman who dreams of summer. [laughs] What could POSSIBLY go wrong?

clues.clue: Rapunzel's loyal pet chameleon in Tangled.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pascal! He changes colors to show how he's feeling, which makes him... [chuckles] the most honest character in the movie.

clues.clue: In Zootopia, Judy and Nick visit the DMV, where they meet this painfully slow sloth.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Flash! Flash, Flash, hundred yard dash. And yes, the DMV is staffed entirely by sloths. [sarcastic] Relatable.

clues.clue: Big Hero 6 takes place in this futuristic mashup of two famous cities.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is San Fransokyo! Look closely and you'll see the Golden Gate Bridge with Japanese-style towers. [excited] Very cool design.

clues.clue: Frozen's Let It Go won the Oscar for this married songwriting duo, who also wrote the music for Coco's Remember Me.
accept: kristen anderson lopez and robert lopez
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Kristen Anderson-Lopez and Robert Lopez! Robert is also one of the few people to win an Emmy, a Grammy, an Oscar, and a Tony. [sarcastic] Overachiever.

categories.title: Who Said It? Modern Edition
categories.intro: You'll hear a famous line from a modern Disney movie. Tell me who said it. [mischievously] Bonus points if you do the voice.

clues.clue: Which demigod says this line?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Maui! [laughs] What can I say except... you're welcome. That's right, I said it.
clues.quote: What can I say except you're welcome!

clues.clue: Which Tangled character says this line while trying to charm his way out of trouble?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Flynn Rider! Also known as Eugene Fitzherbert. [chuckles] The smolder never worked on Rapunzel, but it's legendary anyway.
clues.quote: All right, I didn't want to have to do this, but you leave me no choice. Here comes the smolder.

clues.clue: Which Zootopia character tells Judy Hopps this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Nick Wilde! The smoothest con artist fox in Zootopia. [mischievously] Judy got hustled, and so did the audience.

clues.clue: Which Frozen character sings this line to his best friend?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Kristoff! Singing for Sven, too, since Sven can't talk. [excited] Jonathan Groff does both voices, and both are fantastic.
clues.quote: Reindeers are better than people. Sven, don't you think that's true?

clues.clue: Which Big Hero 6 character teases his little brother with this line?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tadashi! Hiro had just hit a creative wall, so his big brother hung him upside down. [laughs] Look for a new angle, indeed.
clues.quote: Wow. Washed up at fourteen. So sad.

categories.title: Modern Park Magic
categories.intro: Modern movies, modern attractions. [excited] These all opened in the parks in the last decade or so.

clues.clue: This EPCOT boat ride through Arendelle replaced Maelstrom in the Norway pavilion in 2016.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Frozen Ever After! Good news, it has a backwards drop. [sighs] Bad news, everyone in line has Let It Go stuck in their head now.

clues.clue: This Animal Kingdom land, opened in 2017, features floating mountains and bioluminescent plants inspired by James Cameron's films.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pandora, The World of Avatar! Go at night. The plants glow and it feels like you're on another planet. [whispers] Which, technically, you are.

clues.clue: Opened in 2014 in Magic Kingdom's Fantasyland, this family coaster swings you through a gem mine.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Seven Dwarfs Mine Train! The ride vehicles swing side to side. [laughs] Heigh-ho, heigh-ho, it's off to the standby line we go.

clues.clue: This EPCOT walk-through attraction, opened in 2023, lets guests play with living water inspired by a demigod's ocean adventure.
clues.answer: Journey of Water, Inspired by Moana
accept: journey of water inspired by moana
choices: Journey of Water, Inspired by Moana
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Journey of Water, Inspired by Moana! The water jumps away from you, chases you, and sometimes splashes you. Bring a towel, or don't... [chuckles] it's Florida.

clues.clue: In November 2023, this park opened World of Frozen, the world's first Frozen-themed land.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hong Kong Disneyland! [excited] You can ride Wandering Oaken's Sliding Sleighs and visit Arendelle itself. Tokyo DisneySea followed with its own Frozen Kingdom in 2024.

categories.title: Sidekick Squad
categories.intro: Fans love a good sidekick, so this category is all about the animal friends of modern Disney. [excited] Cuteness overload!

clues.clue: Moana's very confused rooster stowaway.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Heihei! Voiced by Alan Tudyk, who has a voice role in nearly every modern Disney animated movie. [laughs] Heihei is his finest work.

clues.clue: Tangled's palace guard sidekick Maximus is this kind of animal.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a horse! But he acts like a bloodhound. [chuckles] Maximus is the only horse who could probably arrest you.

clues.clue: Zootopia's tiny but tough Finnick, who works scams with Nick, is this kind of animal.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a fennec fox! He dresses up as an elephant baby to pull off cons. And he has the deepest voice in Zootopia. [whispers] Don't call him cute.

clues.clue: In Frozen II, the fire spirit of the Enchanted Forest is a little salamander named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Bruni! A purple fire salamander who just wants a snowflake on the tongue. [laughs] Instant merchandise hit.

clues.clue: In 2023's Wish, Asha's pet goat, who suddenly gains the ability to talk, is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Valentino! A goat in pajamas with a surprisingly deep voice. [excited] Somebody give him his own short!
